title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 04
description:
Embrace your love for baseball with this custom Comforter Set from Jeminise, designed to bring personalized sports decor into your home. Perfect for baseball players and fans alike, this set makes a thoughtful gift for men and women, parents, or for special occasions like Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Celebrate determination and love for baseball with a personalized touch.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection dyeing techniques for fade resistance and smooth, compact stitching for durability.
  • Soft & Comfy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling for a soft, comfortable, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat for quick drying and fluffiness.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover.
  • Custom Options: Personalize your bedding with custom text inputs.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Sets
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Fill Material Microfiber
Color Baseball Thunder
Pattern Baseball
Design Personalized Baseball Bedding Set
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
